message.content:
A **G-Wagon** is a **Mercedes-Benz G-Class**, which is a **luxury SUV** with strong **off-road** capability.[1][3]

It’s also commonly described as a **4-door wagon** or **midsize luxury SUV**, and it was originally designed as a rugged utility/off-road vehicle.[5][7][2]
